agreement_text:
C1. A room in a paying guest lodging is offered for INR 8000 monthly with INR 16000 refundable deposit.
C2. The full deposit is forfeited for any breach or early exit.
C3. A cleaning charge of INR 3000 is deducted on departure.
C4. No construction date or occupancy classification has been confirmed.
landlord_pushback: The deposit is always forfeited if you leave early.
Cleaning costs are fixed; I will not show receipts.
Every PG uses this agreement; sign it unchanged.
